why: Rosetta: the PLOS PDF of the article also in the corpus as JATS (epmc-pone.0310152), publisher HTML, LaTeXML, and Grobid TEI. Pins what the PDF shares with the JATS parse: title, abstract opening, the numbered section outline including the bold run-in 2.2.x subsections, one table, twelve figures, and 45 references. The page-1 sidebar (citation, editor, dates, funding) is margin text and stays out; equations set in the TeX math symbol font read as ( ) = + and minus. Its math fonts carry no Unicode mapping, so those glyphs read as U+FFFD, reported as unmapped-glyphs.
title: Effect of vaccine dose intervals: Considering immunity levels, vaccine efficacy, and strain variants for disease control strategy
abstractStartsWith: In this study, we present an immuno-epidemic model to understand mitigation options during an epidemic break.
